pages.title: Astral Alignment Game
pages.text: The goal of the Astral Allignment game is to line up the four different symbols so they are in 4x4 squares. The buttons on each side of a line rotate them 1 towards the pressed button.

pages.title: Holotron Disc
pages.text: The Holotron Disc is used on the Astral Alignment Device to start the game.

pages.title: Astral Plane Analyzer
pages.text: The Astral Plane Analyzer is given for succesfully completing the game.
